manual.treated_wood.line2: {0}Treated wood is any kind of wooden planks impregnated with {1}Creosote Oil{2}.{3}
manual.treated_wood.line3: Despite their simplicity, these weatherproof planks are used throughout industrial matters where a durable wood is needed.{0}
manual.treated_wood.line5: {0}Treated wood can also be used to craft §2Wallmounts§r, which can be very useful to mount connectors in a visually attractive way without using posts.{1}
manual.treated_wood.line6: Wallmounts can be placed facing upwards or downwards, and do not automatically connect to blocks placed near them.
